name: Summit AZ - GSC Indexing Report 2026-08-15
body:
> Report · Summit Az · 2026-08-15

# Summary
Google Page Indexing report for summitplumbingpros.com, window Jul 18 to Aug 14, 2026 (GSC data available through Aug 7). Versions: `.md` and `.pdf`; a trend chart `Summit-GSC-Indexing-Trend-2026-08-15.png` sits alongside.

# Key findings
- Indexed pages rose from 155 (Jul 18) to 164 (Aug 7), +9; not indexed fell from 53 to 46, -7. Total known pages 208 to 210. The improvement landed around Jul 25 and held.
- Crawled, currently not indexed: 13 URLs, including emergency plumber Apache Junction, drain cleaning Queen Creek and Scottsdale, sewer Queen Creek, garbage disposal Chandler and /expert-drain-line-services/, plus harmless feeds and system URLs.
- Discovered, currently not indexed: 9 URLs, including drain cleaning Tempe, faucet and toilet, garbage disposal Fountain Hills and Phoenix, shower and bath, water pressure Phoenix, water softener Apache Junction.
- Not found (404): 4 system or wildcard URLs, including the lead form API endpoint (harmless).
- Page with redirect: 8 (expected).

# Decisions and status
- Many of the same pages stayed not indexed into September; they became the Sep 24 to Oct 9 rewrite targets once duplication was found to be the cause (see [Summit AZ - City Pages Index](lib:brain-summit-az-city-pages-index)).
